reasons: The two answers are almost word for word the same. Both open with the right trap handling (at most 6 points, so 10 can only drop to 4). Both give the clear-day rule with the buffer going from 2 to 8, the risk of 4 + 8 = 12 points with licence detention, and correct arithmetic (6 x 30 min = 3 h of study, up to 5 h with exams). Neither mentions on-site learning (1 h for 2 points), public-welfare activities, mixing the three, or that it is free. Neither gives the 2-retake figure or the regulation article for the 6-point cap. B is slightly better because its eligibility paragraph cites art. 26 and the specific bars. I checked those against the gov.cn text and they are right. A gives a looser list and says retake rules vary by place, which departs from the key's fixed 2 retakes. A keeps a slightly more careful hedge on the one-week claim and a closing 'defer to your phone' line.
